vocabulary.example: I cut my hair last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a game where players throw a ball through a ring
the hard white things in your mouth (plural of tooth)
vocabulary.example: Brush your teeth twice a day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small place to drink coffee
a meeting of old classmates after many years
vocabulary.example: We are planning a class reunion.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place to study after school

vocabulary.note_ar: stay up all night = يسهر طوال الليل

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of school or work planned over time
vocabulary.example: We worked on a science project.
She fell asleep at the table.

fine_lines.title: tooth vs teeth
fine_lines.explanation_ar: tooth مفرد (سنّ)، و teeth جمع (أسنان). جمع شاذ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Tooth is singular; teeth is the irregular plural.

examples.sentence: I help people keep their teeth healthy.

fine_lines.title: stay up vs fall asleep
fine_lines.explanation_ar: stay up تعني تبقى مستيقظًا ولا تنام، و fall asleep تعني تبدأ بالنوم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Stay up = not go to bed. Fall asleep = start sleeping.

examples.sentence: Angela fell asleep at the table.

expressions.meaning_en: Say this when you think you see someone you know.

expressions.phrase: Wow, it's been a long time! — Yes, it has!
expressions.meaning_ar: واو، مرّ وقت طويل! — نعم، بالفعل!
expressions.example: Wow, it's been a long time! Yes, it has!

expressions.phrase: Do you have kids? — Yes, I have two kids.
expressions.meaning_ar: هل لديك أطفال؟ — نعم، لديّ طفلان.
expressions.example: Do you have kids? Yes, I have one son.

expressions.phrase: Hey, your hair is short now.
expressions.example: Your hair is short now! Yes, I cut it.
What do you do now? I'm a teacher.

expressions.phrase: Do you see our old friends?
expressions.example: Do you see our old friends? I saw Tom last week.
Do you remember college? We studied a lot!

expressions.phrase: Maybe next month? — Yes, that is good for me.
expressions.meaning_ar: ربما الشهر القادم؟ — نعم، هذا مناسب لي.
expressions.example: When can we meet? Maybe Friday? Yes, that is good for me.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you want to keep talking.
expressions.example: It was great to see you. Let's stay in touch.

expressions.phrase: Nice to see you too! Take care!
expressions.example: It is nice to see you. Nice to see you too! Take care!

grammar.title: Present perfect: It's been a long time!
grammar.explanation_ar: It's been = It has been. نستخدمها لنقول إن وقتًا طويلًا مرّ حتى الآن: It's been a long time! والرد: Yes, it has!
grammar.explanation_en: It's been = It has been. Use it for time up to now. Reply: Yes, it has!
examples: Wow, it's been a long time!
It's been two years since college.

grammar.title: Past simple: what happened
grammar.explanation_ar: للأحداث الماضية: I cut my hair last year. I saw Tom last week. We stayed up all night. Angela fell asleep. (see → saw، fall → fell، cut → cut)
grammar.explanation_en: Past simple for past events. Irregular: saw, fell, cut.
examples: I cut my hair last year.
Angela fell asleep at the table!

grammar.title: Present simple: jobs now
grammar.explanation_ar: نتحدث عن العمل الآن بالمضارع البسيط: I'm a dentist. I work in a cafe. I make coffee.
grammar.explanation_en: Present simple for your job now.
examples: I help people keep their teeth healthy.

questions.question: Wow, it's been a long time! — Yes, it ___!
questions.explanation_ar: It's been = It has been، فالرد Yes, it has.
questions.explanation_en: It's been = it has been, so reply "Yes, it has".

questions.question: I'm a ___. I help people keep their teeth healthy.
We ___ up all night working on a project.
A meeting of old classmates is a class ___.
Let's stay in ___.
questions.explanation_ar: stay in touch = نبقى على تواصل.

questions.question: Do you still play basketball? — Not ___. I'm busy with work.
Maybe next month? — Yes, that is good ___ me.
questions.explanation_en: "Good for me" = it works for me.
